walls.notes: 3 St Mary's Passage (listed, wikidata Q98175669): small 17th-c. house, white pargetted (moulded fleur-de-lys plaster) front, not brick. Geograph 7561311 / Commons 3 St Mary's Passage: panelled oak door at the east end under a shell hood, 6-light leaded shop window, 3-light leaded oriel on the first floor with bracketed cornice, steep tiled gable dormer with 2-light leaded window and finial. Trim cream-grey. Previous annotation (red brick, from a blurred photo) was wrong.
